hooks.command: cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$cmd" | grep -qE '^git push'; then leaked=$( { git diff @{upstream}..HEAD 2>/dev/null || git diff HEAD^ HEAD 2>/dev/null; } | grep -E '^\+[^+]' | grep -E "(AIza[0-9A-Za-z_-]{35}|sk-ant-[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+|sk_live_[a-zA-Z0-9]+|sk_test_[a-zA-Z0-9]+|SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*[^[:space:]]+|sbp_[a-zA-Z0-9]{40})" 2>/dev/null ); if [ -n "$leaked" ]; then echo "{\"decision\":\"block\",\"reason\":\"Possible secrets detected in committed diff — push blocked.\"}"; exit 2; fi; fi

file=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' 2>/dev/null); repo=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [[ "$file" == *.py ]]; then ruff check "$file" 2>/dev/null || true; mypy "$file" --ignore-missing-imports 2>/dev/null || true; elif [[ "$file" == *.ts || "$file" == *.tsx ]]; then cd "$repo/frontend" && npx tsc --noEmit 2>/dev/null || true; fi
